data.new_camera_policy: When a new camera shows up
data.new_device_policy: When any other new device shows up
data.wifi_raw_log: Wi-Fi coverage: keep a raw log of each reading

data_description.new_camera_policy: notify (default): just tell me. block_internet: cut a camera that is new to the network off from the internet right away (it keeps working on your network; trust it to undo). off: do nothing.
data_description.new_device_policy: notify: one notification listing new devices. off: do nothing.
data_description.wifi_raw_log: Off by default. Only with Wi-Fi coverage (PadSpan HA with PadSpan Pro or its Wi-Fi coverage add-on). On: every reading is also written, with where PadSpan had the device (its name, Wi-Fi address, room and spot), to unifi_utopia_wifi_survey/ in your config folder, one file a day, kept 7 days. For looking into the readings yourself; the coverage map doesn't need it.
